note: Had a long dinner with Leo last night and he had a lot going on. He finally signed the lease on the apartment in Pilsen and moves in on November 15, so he's spending every weekend until then packing. His sister Carla is getting married in June and asked him to give a toast, which he's nervous about because he hates public speaking. He mentioned his mom's knee is finally better after the surgery in August and she's walking the dog again. Work-wise he got moved onto the platform team and his new manager is someone he actually likes for once. He's been getting really into film photography, bought an old Pentax, and wants to do a darkroom class in the winter. He is still running, did a 10K last weekend in under fifty minutes, and wants to try a half marathon in the spring. We talked about doing a camping trip to the Dunes together in May. He also asked me to send him the name of the contractor who did our kitchen, so I owe him that. Rocket has been limping a bit and he's taking him to the vet on Friday. Oh, and his birthday is December 3, he wants to do dinner at that Ethiopian place he loves.
